name: momentum
vibe: A bold dark launch film, engineered. A graphite-black ground under heavy flush-LEFT display type that slides in like a countdown, with one hot-orange accent igniting the word that matters. Space-mono HUD chrome frames every shot — corner brackets, a running timecode, /01 section numbers, a live audio waveform and a faint dotted grid — so the film reads like mission control for a product launch. Left-aligned, asymmetric, confident; motion is decisive slides and pushes, never drift-soup. For product launches, feature reveals, manifestos, hype reels and anything that ships with momentum.
